title: 开关断开后的欠阻尼全响应
statement: 图示电路中 Us = 12 V，R = 1 Ω，L = 0.5 H，C = 0.2 F，R2 = 3 Ω。开关 S 闭合已久，t = 0 时断开，R2 被切除。
求 i_L(0₊)、t > 0 时的特征根，以及 t = π/6 s 时的 u_C 和 t = π/3 s 时的 i_L。

questions.explain: t < 0 直流稳态：电感短路、电容开路，i_L = Us/(R + R2) = 12/4 = 3 A，u_C = R2·i_L = 9 V。换路定则：i_L(0₊) = 3 A，u_C(0₊) = 9 V。

questions.ask: 特征根 s₁,₂ = −α ± jω_d 的实部 = ?
questions.explain: t > 0 为 Us、R、L、C 串联：s² + (R/L)s + 1/(LC) = s² + 2s + 10 = 0 → s = −1 ± j3，实部 −α = −1 s⁻¹。注意 √10 是 ω₀ 而不是 ω_d。

questions.ask: 特征根 s₁ = −α + jω_d 的虚部 ω_d = ?
questions.explain: 虚部就是阻尼振荡角频率 ω_d = 3 rad/s。
i_L = C·du_C/dt = e^(−t)(3cos 3t + sin 3t) A。t = π/3：cos π = −1，sin π = 0，i_L = −3e^(−π/3) ≈ −1.053 A（电流已反向）。

hints: t < 0：电感短路、电容开路，求 i_L(0₋)、u_C(0₋)。
t > 0：Us、R、L、C 串联，u_C 的全解 = 稳态分量 u_C(∞) + 暂态分量 e^(−αt)(A₁cos ω_d t + A₂sin ω_d t)。
第二个初始条件：i_L 从左向右流入电容正极板，du_C/dt(0₊) = i_L(0₊)/C。
solution: **4. 电感电流。** i_L = C·du_C/dt = 0.2 × e^(−t)(15cos 3t + 5sin 3t) = e^(−t)(3cos 3t + sin 3t) A，验算 i_L(0) = 3 A ✓。

en.title: Underdamped complete response after a switch opens
statement: In the circuit Us = 12 V, R = 1 Ω, L = 0.5 H, C = 0.2 F, R2 = 3 Ω. Switch S has been closed for a long time and opens at t = 0, disconnecting R2.
Find i_L(0+), the characteristic roots for t > 0, u_C at t = π/6 s and i_L at t = π/3 s.

questions.explain: DC steady state for t < 0: L shorted, C open, i_L = Us/(R + R2) = 12/4 = 3 A and u_C = R2·i_L = 9 V. Switching rules: i_L(0+) = 3 A, u_C(0+) = 9 V.

questions.ask: Real part of the characteristic roots s₁,₂ = −α ± jω_d = ?
questions.explain: For t > 0 it is Us, R, L, C in series: s² + (R/L)s + 1/(LC) = s² + 2s + 10 = 0 → s = −1 ± j3, real part −α = −1 1/s. Note that √10 is ω₀, not ω_d.

questions.ask: Imaginary part of s₁ = −α + jω_d, i.e. ω_d = ?
questions.explain: The imaginary part is the damped angular frequency ω_d = 3 rad/s.
u_C = 12 + e^(−t)(−3cos 3t + 4sin 3t) V. At t = π/6, cos(π/2) = 0 and sin(π/2) = 1: u_C = 12 + 4e^(−π/6) ≈ 14.370 V (above the source voltage).
i_L = C·du_C/dt = e^(−t)(3cos 3t + sin 3t) A. At t = π/3, cos π = −1 and sin π = 0: i_L = −3e^(−π/3) ≈ −1.053 A (the current has reversed).

hints: For t < 0: L shorted, C open — find i_L(0−) and u_C(0−).
For t > 0: Us, R, L, C in series; the complete u_C = steady-state part u_C(∞) + transient part e^(−αt)(A₁cos ω_d t + A₂sin ω_d t).
The second initial condition: i_L flows left to right into the capacitor's + plate, so du_C/dt(0+) = i_L(0+)/C.
solution: **3. Complete response.** u_C = 12 + e^(−t)(A₁cos 3t + A₂sin 3t). u_C(0+) = 9 → A₁ = −3; u_C′(0+) = −A₁ + 3A₂ = 15 → A₂ = 4. u_C = 12 + e^(−t)(−3cos 3t + 4sin 3t) = 12 − 5e^(−t)cos(3t + 53.13°) V.
**4. Inductor current.** i_L = C·du_C/dt = 0.2 × e^(−t)(15cos 3t + 5sin 3t) = e^(−t)(3cos 3t + sin 3t) A; check i_L(0) = 3 A ✓.
